links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

results.description: List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of documents available. MongoDB Cloud omits this value if `includeCount` is set to `false`. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact.

DatasetRetentionPolicy.description: Dataset Retention Policy for a Scheduled Data Lake Pipeline.

lastModifiedDate.description: Date when retention policy was last modified. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

units.description: Quantity of time in which the Data Lake Pipeline measures dataset retention.

value.description: Number that indicates the amount of days, weeks, or months that the Data Lake Pipeline will retain datasets.

DatasetRetentionPolicy.title: Dataset Retention Policy

IngestionPipelineRun.description: Run details of a Data Lake Pipeline.

_id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies a Data Lake Pipeline run.

backupFrequencyType.description: Backup schedule interval of the Data Lake Pipeline.

createdDate.description: Timestamp that indicates when the pipeline run was created. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

datasetName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the dataset that Atlas generates during this pipeline run. You can use this dataset as a `dataSource` in a Federated Database collection.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the project.

lastUpdatedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time that the pipeline run was updated. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

phase.description: Processing phase of the Data Lake Pipeline.

pipelineId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies a Data Lake Pipeline.

scheduledDeletionDate.description: Timestamp that indicates when the pipeline run will expire and its dataset will be deleted. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

snapshotId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the snapshot of a cluster.

IngestionPipelineRun.title: Data Lake Pipeline Run

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

PipelineRunStats.description: Runtime statistics for this Data Lake Pipeline run.

bytesExported.description: Total data size in bytes exported for this pipeline run.

numDocs.description: Number of docs ingested for a this pipeline run.

PipelineRunStats.title: Data Lake Pipeline Run Statistics
